create.name: Amron Bevels
create.bio:
Amron Bevels lives, as she puts it, at the intersection of worlds society insists should stay separate: science and spirituality, medicine and mysticism. A conventionally trained medical doctor who chose not to practise in order to follow her soul’s mission, she brings a physician’s rigour and a lifelong student’s curiosity — neuroscience, psycho-immunology, functional nutrition, vibrational medicine — to work that is unapologetically mystical: psychic development teaching, energy healing, and the mentorship of spiritually awakening women.

She is the grounded receiver and anchor of The Priestess Transmissions (with Amy Belair), the channelled codex of the divine feminine that has become Awaken Village Press’s flagship spiritual work, and the author of LightCodes of Money, her guide for healers and intuitives breaking free of scarcity programming to claim prosperity as inner mastery. Through her mentorship containers, leaders’ circles, and communities of what she calls phenomenal women, Amron teaches self-mastery with a doctor’s groundedness and an oracle’s reach — a bridge, in one person, between the clinic and the temple.

books.title: The Priestess Transmissions
books.author: Amron Bevels and Amy Belair
books.description: Co-written with Amy Belair, this book is a set of channelled transmissions first received during the Great Conjunction of 2020. It is written for women who feel their intuition and sensitivity growing, and who want to embody the Priestess archetype. It reads less like a self-help book and more like an initiation into divine feminine leadership and inner authority.

books.title: LightCodes of Money: Opening the Vault of Prosperity for Healers, Coaches & Guides
books.author: Amron Bevels
books.description: An oracle-style code book for healers, coaches and intuitives who have done deep inner work but still struggle with money. Amron Bevels combines spiritual insight, energy awareness and nervous system wisdom to undo the old belief that service must mean sacrifice. It is a guide to building wealth from self-worth and alignment.

courses.title: Leaders Circle Membership
courses.description: A quarterly gathering space for intuitive women who feel called to spiritual leadership. It includes a monthly live Ceremonial Sync Up and ongoing conversation in a private WhatsApp group.

courses.title: The Founders Club
courses.description: A private, invitation-style mastermind for high-frequency leaders. It is a peer think tank for launching ideas, with live calls and support from colleagues, billed monthly over one year.

courses.title: Lightcode Curriculum Journey
courses.description: An eight-module companion course to The Priestess Transmissions, released weekly. It takes students deeper into the codes and activations of the book to help them awaken their spiritual gifts.

courses.title: The Money Upgrade
courses.description: A four-week spiritual money bootcamp. It works on the energetic and subconscious blocks that limit how much abundance you can receive.

courses.title: Lightcodes of Money Broadcast (Full Year)
courses.description: A year of short audio transmissions, energy resets and somatic practices, delivered on Telegram. They are designed to retrain your money beliefs and raise your capacity to receive.

courses.title: The Permission Slip
courses.description: A rolling group programme with weekly audio, live hot seats and group work on receiving. You can stay for one to three months.

courses.title: The Priestess Transmissions Audiobook
courses.description: Amron reads the full set of Priestess transmissions aloud. It lets listeners take in the channelled activations by ear.

courses.title: Telegram Lightcode Activation Series
courses.description: Two weeks of recorded audio activations, available on Telegram. It is a low-cost first taste of Amron’s lightcode work.

courses.title: Connect to Your Shaman Codes
courses.description: A recorded activation session (“The Archetype of Woman”) for reconnecting with your inner shamanic lineage and archetypal feminine power.

courses.title: Dragon Lightbody Activation
courses.description: A short recorded activation to help you sense and awaken your “dragon light body.” It suits seekers exploring their subtle energetic anatomy.

courses.title: Letter to the Priestess: An Activation
courses.description: A sacred-space activation for women answering the Priestess call. It also works as a warm-up for the Leaders Circle.
